agile and lightweight small-bodied theropod frame
long slender hind legs built for quick balancing steps
stiff straight counter-balancing tail held horizontally

layer_3_action.action: A composed, non-aggressive Masiakasaurus with clean high-poly clay geometry is standing calmly behind a stylized Late Cretaceous cycad shrub, tilting its head downward with a quiet curiosity. The camera captures a stable three-quarter profile at a neutral eye-level view, framing its unique forward-jutting snout silhouette and slender, horizontal frame without any scary lunging poses or cartoonish infant roundness. It is observing a tiny clay beetle resting on a cracked mud line under soft, cinematic studio ambient occlusion lighting. No text.
